title: Building Scalable Systems with Apache Airflow: A Data Engineer's Guide
tldr: This guide explores advanced patterns for scaling Apache Airflow, focusing on choosing the right executors, optimizing DAG structures, and leveraging custom XCom backends. It demonstrates how to decouple compute from orchestration and use deferrable operators to handle enterprise-level data workloads efficiently.
excerpt: Learn how to scale Apache Airflow past its common bottlenecks with custom XCom backends, deferrable operators, and Kubernetes architecture patterns designed by a senior data engineer.
keywords: Building Scalable Systems with Apache Airflow: A Data Engineer's Guide
